name: toolrun-corner-clip-phone
description: A folded tool run that stands on its own (widgets/disclosure's details inside surface.module.css's tool-run segment) keeps the tool-row contracts in the real cascade on a phone. The Open control in the run's last row is 44px tall and overhangs its line; a tap one pixel inside its top or bottom edge reaches the control. The open run's first row sits flush with its summary, with Disclosure's --space-1 top gap cancelled, and the last row's evidence band spans its row with no unexpected inset.

allowlist..body: The case prefixes disclosure.module.css's classes to disclosure-* and toolcallitem's to toolcall-*, so resolved.css has no shared .body selector; the collision is only in the raw stylesheets.
allowlist..chevron: The case prefixes disclosure and toolcallitem classes, so resolved.css has no shared .chevron selector; the fixture's leading chevron uses widgets/chevron/chevron.module.css.
allowlist..summary: Same prefixing: Disclosure's summary and ToolRunGroup's summary resolve to different selectors in this case.

mutation.declaration: fixture-only, temporarily in harness.html, one at a time and restored after each run: .body { overflow: clip }, .toolcall-row { overflow: clip }, .toolcall-body { margin-inline: 0 }, .body { margin-top: 0 }
mutation.note: Four mutations, one at a time, each restored before the next. Clipping the run body fails on the control's top edge; clipping the row fails on both edges, which covers the bottom-edge assertion (the details' own overhang outside its box is subpixel, so a one-pixel-inside tap there is not clipped). Zeroing the evidence band's inline bleed insets it inside its row; zeroing the run body's top margin restores Disclosure's uncancelled 4px gap above the first row. The production stylesheets were not modified.
